ideas.name: potE1 repeated within 10 bars
ideas.why: a second easing on the EMA row soon after the first cleared is momentum failing to rebuild

ideas.name: potM5 repeated within 15 minutes
ideas.why: the same on the 5m MACD row

ideas.name: both 1m rows warning together
ideas.why: the MACD and EMA rows easing at once is a broader slowdown than one row

ideas.name: three bars of easing
ideas.why: a MACD row that has stayed in its warning for three bars is a sustained loss of momentum, not a one-bar wobble

ideas.name: MACD warning cleared, trend resumes
ideas.why: a warning that clears back to the plain side without a cross is a failed reversal; those who acted on it are trapped and the trend resumes

ideas.name: EMA warning cleared, trend resumes
ideas.why: the same on the EMA row

ideas.name: potM1 with price stalled
ideas.why: momentum easing while price has also failed to make a new 10-bar extreme for 5 bars: both stalling
